# table-column-style

- ID: `MD060`
- Category: Tables
- Default: on, severity warning
- Fixable: no
- Tags: `table`

Each table follows one style: aligned pipes, one space of padding, or none.

## Why

A table that follows one style is easier to read in the source.

## Options

Set them under `rules.table-column-style.options`.

- `style` (`string`, default `any`): Cell padding to require. any accepts
  whichever of aligned, compact and tight a table comes closest to. Values:
  `any`, `aligned`, `compact`, `tight`.
- `aligned_delimiter` (`boolean`, default `false`): With the compact or tight
  style, require the pipes of the delimiter row to line up with those of the
  header row.
- `markdownlint_compatible` (`boolean`, default `true`, gomdlint only): With the
  style any, report padding that matches no style, as markdownlint does. With
  false, any padding is allowed.

## Fix

There is no automatic fix.

## Configure

```yaml
rules:
  table-column-style:
    options:
      style: any
```

Under `rules`, `table-column-style: false` turns the rule off and
`table-column-style: error` reports its findings as errors. The flag
`--disable table-column-style` turns it off for one run.

## Silence one line

```markdown
<!-- markdownlint-disable-next-line table-column-style -->
```
